rules.statement: Where land is divided into an eastern and western half by agreement, a conveyance for an undivided share of the eastern half conveys rights to that entire corpus, even if described as 'undivided' in the deed.
rules.supporting_quote: "Admittedly what was possessed by the co-owners of that half was a divided eastern half, but, in possessing that half by arrangement, the co-owners, Sedris and Abilinu, who obtained that half under the deed in their favour. in 1924, were allowed to possess an extra portion over the western boundary of that half, so that the eastern half came to be regarded as a certain corpus which included the whole of the actual eastern half."
